input: How many items do I currently sell in my store?

scenario: 跨域相似词: 库存归 products (inventory), 不归 orders
input: 把 SKU ABC-001 的库存数量同步成仓库实际数量

notes: 库存/仓库 wording can smell like fulfillment; inventory lives in the products domain.
